dex.entry: The cloud-pup's fur has densified into cumulonimbus wool that flashes with internal lightning; it's cheerful but the gold-edged static halos around its body scatter light in every direction. A golden glow behind storm-grey clouds — every battle with it feels like watching a storm roll in.
